facts.fact: The historic centre combines Inca stonework and viceregal architecture.
Plaza de Armas contains the Cathedral Basilica of the Virgin of the Assumption, with Cusco-school paintings.
Hatunrumiyoc contains the twelve-angled stone in a wall of the palace of Inca Roca.
Qorikancha was an important Inca centre of worship associated with the sun, moon and stars.
The historic centre is at approximately 3,399 metres above sea level.
